product_one_liner.value: Nanonets provides AI document-processing agents that extract structured data and automate document-heavy workflows for enterprise operations and finance teams.

employee_band.notes: Current profile and job-listing counts of 327 and 333 fall in this band; other directories report lower counts.

eng_blog.notes: The research publication series includes OCR-s training details by Souvik Mandal and the OCR-3 research-team devlog covering training, inference and Mixture-of-Experts architecture; these are distinct from marketing tutorials.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Deep Learning Engineer posting covers LLMs, VLMs, NLP and computer vision; the company job board also lists Senior Deep Learning Engineer and VP of AI.

model_provider.value: Nanonets OCR-3; Nanonets-OCR-s, fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-3B; Amazon Textract and Google Vision as selectable OCR engines in the on-prem offering.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the company’s public claims. HIPAA and GDPR are compliance frameworks, not independent certifications. No Nanonets PCI DSS certification is asserted.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was announced March 12, 2024, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

launched_6mo.notes: Atlas, a Nanonets company-context product, launched June 26, 2026, within the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Shubhra Mishra’s profile lists a March 2026 start as Vice President, Strategic Initiatives at Nanonets, within the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are explicitly named customer-facing CRM integrations, not proof of Nanonets’ internal CRM deployment.
